signature_items.suit_reason: Number sourced; the suit is SPADES, matching CHAR-gardener-two, CHAR-gardener-seven and CHAR-royal-gardeners-ensemble. BIB-0029 (DEF-p4-char-301) moved the gardeners from clubs to spades. The source names the gardeners' numbers but never their suit, while ch008-p11 'ten soldiers carrying clubs' anchors the club suit to the soldiers; the club suit has only thirteen cards and ten soldiers plus the King and Queen of Clubs (CHAR-visiting-monarchs-ensemble M01/M02) already fill twelve of them, so no club rank was left for a gardener. Spades also fit garden staff. The numeral -- the only thing the source fixes and the only thing that identifies the figure on screen -- is unchanged.
